jobs.description: Man-up order picker (HLO) - Moerdijk -  €14.99 per uur - Logistics - 36 hour Would you like to work as an HLO (Man-up) order picker at the major logistics company Van der Helm? The work is performed using a high-level combi truck. The operator sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is spacious enough for the worker to sit and move safely. The machine can reach heights of up to 12-16 meters, and the operator rises together with the cabin. Before ascending, the operator places an empty pallet on the forks. Occasionally, a full pallet is placed on the forks if it needs to be stored in the rack. When you are high in the air, you take boxes from the shelves by hand. The boxes can weigh between 15 and 20 kilos, depending on the product. The operator places the boxes on the empty pallet or places full pallets into the rack. After finishing the task, the machine descends. The operator then drives the truck to another location in the warehouse.  Job Requirements  - HLO (Man-up) certificate or willingness to obtain one - Not afraid to work at heights - Physically fit for work - English-speaking - Detail-oriented  Employment conditions  - Employment contract with Charlie Works - Training and courses provided for the HLO if you are not experienced but willing to learn. - Health insurance - Possibility of organized accommodation and organized transport to work - Weekly payments and opportunities for professional growth - Travel allowance - Work in a modern logistics environment - Canteen where you can get food and drinks
